name: grid-card-assemble
description: N capability cards (thin-line icon that draws on, mono label, optional muted body) stagger-assemble into a grid or vertical list with a fade plus short slide into slot, then hold perfectly still.

vars.description: Comma-separated cards (3 to 12). "Label: body" adds a one-line muted body under the label.
Grid wraps by columns; list stacks vertically.
Grid column count (grid layout only). 0 picks automatically: one row up to 3 items, then ceil(sqrt(N)).
Comma-separated per-item entrance times in seconds. Blank entries use the default cascade.
Accent token family used by the card icons.
How the assembled layout leaves the frame. Default none: the hold ends the film.
